findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "compare_energy" is 3252 chars, far longer than this server's median (409). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mobile_plan_details · Private data: get_mobile_plan_details, rate_veritaset · Public sink: find_better_plan, list_supported_countries · Destructive: get_usage_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mobile_plan_details · Private data: get_mobile_plan_details, rate_veritaset · Public sink: find_better_plan, list_supported_countries · Destructive: get_usage_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_mobile_plan_details" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
